data.heading: Clear counsel for decisions that matter.
data.subheading: Corporate advisory, commercial litigation, property and family law from a team of 40 advocates in Mumbai and Delhi.

data.heading: Three decades of trusted legal advice
data.description:
Harbor & Co. was founded in 1994 by two advocates who wanted a firm that combined courtroom strength with practical commercial sense.

Today our partners advise listed companies, family businesses and individuals on transactions, disputes and property — always with partner-level attention.

data.heading: Common questions

items.question: Is the first consultation confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Everything you share is protected by advocate–client privilege from the first conversation.

items.question: How are fees structured?
items.answer: Fixed fees for defined work, and hourly or stage-wise fees for litigation, agreed in writing upfront.

items.question: Do you appear outside Mumbai?
items.answer: Yes. We appear before courts and tribunals across India and in international arbitrations.

items.question: Can you review a contract urgently?
items.answer: Yes. Urgent reviews can usually be turned around within 48 hours.
